title: Ocean's Eight | 30A Escapes
meta_description: BEACH ACCESS UPDATE: Due to Hurricane Isaias, private beach access for this property is temporarily unavailable. Nearby public beach access points remain available for guests to enjoy during their stay. We appreciate your understanding as our community continues to recover.
description_expanded: Description Description BEACH ACCESS UPDATE: Due to Hurricane Isaias, private beach access for this property is temporarily unavailable. Nearby public beach access points remain available for guests to enjoy during their stay. We appreciate your understanding as our community continues to recover.30A ESCAPES presents… “Ocean’s Eight,” a spacious 4,692 sq. ft. coastal retreat in Seacrest West! Take in beautiful Gulf views from the upper level, relax by your private seasonally heated pool or challenge the family to a game of ping pong in the game room. With 10 bikes included and room for up to 28 guests, this 8-bedroom home is perfect for family gatherings, celebrations and vacations with friends. Learn more below...👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Private Seasonally Heated Pool: Relax in your private, fenced-in pool with an expansive deck for soaking in the sun or dining under the stars. Pool heating is available Sept-April.Spacious Outdoor Living: Enjoy a private backyard with a covered porch, outdoor dining areas and plenty of room to gather around the pool.10 Bikes Included: Explore Scenic Highway 30A and the surrounding communities with bikes provided for your stay.Expansive Third-Floor Game Room: A spacious second living area featuring chaise lounges, ping pong, an arcade game machine, chess table, wet bar and balcony overlooking the pool.Chef's Dream Kitchen: Equipped with double ovens and dishwashers, TWO full-size refrigerators, an ice maker and ample dining space for entertaining large groups.Room for Everyone: 8 thoughtfully designed bedrooms accommodating up to 28 guests, each with a dedicated bathroom for added privacy.Partial Gulf Views: Take in views of the Gulf and beautiful sunsets from the 3rd-floor balcony.Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "There was plenty of room, lots of seating at dinner time, and the pool was so fun!" – Claudia M.⭐ "We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Oceans Eight! Lots of room and very accommodating and very clean!" - Joanne B.⭐ "Been vacationing in the area for over 40 years. Oceans Eight is by far the most accommodating place that we have stayed. The house, communication and service was exceptional in every way!!" - Judy S.*** LIVING AREAS ***With two spacious living areas, Ocean's Eight offers plenty of room for everyone to spread out and relax. The first-floor open-concept living room features comfortable seating, a large flat-screen TV and beautiful interiors, making it a welcoming space for gathering with family and friends.Head upstairs to the expansive third-floor living area, perfect for a kids' retreat, game nights or simply enjoying some downtime. Challenge someone to ping pong, play a round on the arcade machine or settle in for a game of chess. Relax on the chaise lounges or grab a drink from the wet bar before stepping onto the balcony overlooking the pool.Spacious first-floor living room with comfortable seating and large flat-screen TVExpansive third-floor living area with chaise lounge seatingPing pong table, arcade game machine and chess table with seating for 4Wet bar with mini fridge for drinks and snacksDirect access to the third-floor balcony overlooking the private pool*** KITCHEN & DINING ***The gourmet kitchen is fully equipped to handle meals for large gatherings with ease. Featuring double dishwashers, dual refrigerators and spacious dining areas, it makes hosting both convenient and enjoyable.Kitchen featuring a 5-burner gas range, double dishwashers and TWO refrigeratorsDedicated pantry equipped with a prep sink and ice maker for added convenienceSpacious dining area with two large tables and a 5-seat breakfast bar, perfect for shared meals*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***The private backyard offers plenty of space to relax and spend time together. Whether you're grilling by the pool, dining on the covered porch or enjoying a sunny afternoon on the spacious pool deck, this outdoor area is designed for making the most of your stay.Private seasonally heated pool with beautiful water features. Pool heating available September through AprilLarge propane grill for outdoor cookingSpacious, well-lit pool deck with ample seatingCovered back porch with outdoor dining options*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor:King Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-Suite with single vanity & walk-in showerPowder Room: Conveniently located off the kitchen2nd Floor:Front King Guest Suite: King bed, Twin-over-Twin bunk bed, flat-screen TV, balcony access and En-Suite with single vanity & walk-in shower.Rear King Guest Suite: King bed, Twin-over-Twin bunk bed, flat-screen TV, balcony access and En-Suite with single vanity & walk-in shower.Front King Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, balcony access and En-Suite with single vanity & shower/tub combo.Rear King Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, balcony access and En-Suite with dual vanities & walk-in shower.3rd Floor:King Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, balcony access and En-Suite with single vanity & walk-in showerTwin Bunk Room: Two Custom Twin-over-Twin bunk beds, complete with individual media screens, balcony access and En-Suite with single vanity and shower/tub combo.Full Bunk Room: Two custom Full-over-Full bunk beds, complete with individual media screens and En-Suite with single vanity and shower/tub combo.*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located in Seacrest West, “Ocean’s Eight” offers a convenient home base for exploring Scenic Highway 30A. Take advantage of the 10 provided bikes to visit nearby communities, enjoy local restaurants or browse the shops in Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach.Alys Beach: Known for its beautiful white architecture, scenic green spaces and local diningRosemary Beach: Charming streets, boutique shopping, restaurants and coffee shopsThe Big Chill: A lively gathering spot offering dining, live entertainment and family-friendly activities*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to the 10 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.Off-street parking is available for up to 5 cars, and the backyard is fully fenced for privacy.LSV (Low Speed Vehicles) are NOT allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.There is an active camera at the front door of the home.If you rent for a wedding or wedding function, there is a non-refundable $2,500 event fee.*** YOUR STAY – OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 guest support and an immaculate home designed for comfort, connection, and coastal charm.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 98364STRO #: STR-098364 Read less
